text: I like that I can rewash my teenage boy's shirts until the funk is gone and unlike a big washer, which would take 1 hour per wash (and I usually need 3 washes) it only takes 15 minutes per wash. The thing needs to be drained and then drained AGAIN, and the spin needs to stay on until the water stops or you get problems. I had the 10 lb rovsun which lasted until 6 months, but it was because I didn't do what I just told y'all. It has to be elevated, but the water will pump UP to the toilet on the science of siphoning. Just get it going and it'll pump up into your toilet to drain, but will still have water that needs to be hand shaken out. It's great for teenage puberty funk though! Washing my teenager's shirts 3x only takes 1 hour as opposed to 3 in a big machine. Also, CLEAN AFTER USE, I use a paper towel since the hair and dirt get stuck on the surface of the washer. Great product for pubescent teenagers.

Used it for  four weeks while waiting for my new washer to arrive and did the job for us, a family of two. It’s very light weight, cleans clothes and dry spins quite well. Beats washing by hand, for me. The labor involves pouring the water in directly or by attaching a funnel to the inlet tubes, remembering to shut off the drain valve first before rinse washing. I still needed to hang dry or use my dryer to completely dry the fabrics. It has 2 washing speeds, normal and delicates, has decent agitation, and you can spin on one side while you’re washing on the other side, has a small lint filter and is very quiet. Wash timer is adjustable, up to 12min. Just repeat if you want more time. You can spray water thru the hose while it spin dries to do extra rinsing. I used it outside. Drawbacks: because it’s very lightweight it can move around, so i placed it inside the bottom piece of the styrofoam shipping block. The housing is plastic so handle with care. Spin drum is like stainless steel which is excellent. Only handles small batches at a time, 5 undies,couple of socks and a shirt, or volume of two bath towels or 1 bedsheet. Ok for batchelors and if you have patience. I still preferred using it vs driving to waiting for and giving quarters to the laundromat store. Portable enough to use in motel, campground, for lite duty.

I gave this an overall rating of 3 stars because of broken switch.  I was excited to try this portable washer and finally used it for the 1st time but I could not drain the tub after washing.  The knob appears to be broken.. I had to manually scoop the water from the tub after washing.  The Wash Timer and Spin Timer knobs worked but when I turned the Select knob to Drain...Nothing happened.  I thought maybe there was a clog so I checked the hose and even elevated the machine to ensure gravity would allow the water to drain out but nothing...I then proceeded to test the spin timer to see if the water would drain from the clothes and to my surprise it worked so clearly the hose was not the issue.  Very upset.  Whats the point of using a portable washer if I have to manually drain the water after washing and rinsing the clothes?  I had to scoop all the water out since clothes were wet and it was really annoying and ruined the entire experience.. In fairness the washer worked great and the spinner is awesome...I only set it to 2 or 3 and almost all the water was removed from the clothes so I knew they would not take long to dry.  For this reason I still would recommend a portable washer however due to this drain problem with this specific washer, I don't think I would get another one from this brand.  Sadly disappointed.
